Features

What you get.

  • Leads & pipeline

    See every lead by stage, from first call to won or lost, and who on your team owns it.

  • Contacts

    People and organisations in one place, with the full history of every conversation.

  • Quotations

    Build and send quotes in Kwacha straight from the deal you’re working on.

  • Email inside the CRM

    Each business gets its own inbox in Zed CRM, so emails sit next to the customer they belong to.

  • Click-to-call & WhatsApp

    Call or message a customer from their record in one tap.

  • Works on your phone

    Install Zed CRM as an app on Android or iPhone. No app store needed.

  • Your data, kept separate

    Every business’s records are kept on their own, never mixed with anyone else’s.

Pricing

Priced in Kwacha. Every plan starts free.

Every plan is free for the first 3 months, with no credit card. Prices are per business, per month, in Kwacha. Pay by Airtel Money, MTN MoMo, Zamtel Kwacha or cash.

  • Starter

    K50/month

    For a small team running its first CRM.

    • Up to 3 users
    • Up to 500 leads
    • Up to 200 contacts
    • Email from your own domain
    • Email integration
    • Reporting & dashboard
    Start free trial

  • Growth

    K150/month

    For teams with more people and more leads.

    • Up to 10 users
    • Up to 2,000 leads
    • Up to 5,000 contacts
    • Email from your own domain
    • Email integration
    • Reporting & dashboard
    Start free trial

  • Pro

    K500/month

    For larger teams that want no caps and priority support.

    • Unlimited users, leads and contacts
    • Email from your own domain
    • Email integration
    • Reporting & dashboard
    • Priority support
    Start free trial
